EC1: Morbidly obese [OR] patients (BMI >47 kg/m2) and overweight [OR]/lean patients (BMI <27 kg/m2)
EC2: Evidence of type 1 diabetes [OR] and diabetics requiring insulin therapy.
EC3: Subjects who have [NOT] not been weight stable (>2 kg weight change in past 3 months)
EC4: Subjects who have been recently active (>30 min of moderate/high intensity exercise, 2 times/week).
EC5: Subjects who are smokers [OR] or who have quit smoking <5 years ago
EC6: Subjects prescribed metformin [OR] or have taken metformin within 1 year.
EC7: Subjects with abnormal estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR).
EC8: Hypertriglyceridemic [OR] (>400 mg/dl) and hypercholesterolemic (>260 mg/dl) subjects
EC10: Subjects currently taking medications that affect heart rate and rhythm (i.e. Ca++ channel blockers [OR], nitrates [OR], alpha- [OR] or beta-blockers).
EC11: Subjects with a history of significant metabolic [OR], cardiac [OR], congestive heart failure [OR], cerebrovascular [OR], hematological [OR], pulmonary [OR], gastrointestinal [OR], liver [OR], renal [OR], or endocrine disease [OR] or cancer that in the investigator's opinion would interfere with or alter the outcome measures, or impact subject safety.
EC12: Pregnant [OR] (as evidenced by positive pregnancy test) or nursing women
EC13: Subjects with contraindications to participation in an exercise training program
EC14: Currently taking active weight suppression medication (e.g. phentermine [OR],orlistat [OR], lorcaserin [OR], naltrexone-bupropion in combination [OR], liraglutide [OR], benzephetamine [OR], diethylpropion [OR], phendimetrazine)
EC15: Known hypersensitivity [AND] to perflutren (contained in Definity)
